# Balaji Amines Limited – Company Introduction

Balaji Amines Limited is a prominent and well-established chemical manufacturing company headquartered at 165-A Railway Lines, Solapur - 413001, Maharashtra, India. Founded with a vision to become a leading producer of specialty chemicals, the company has grown remarkably over the decades to establish itself as one of India's foremost manufacturers of aliphatic amines and their derivatives, as well as specialty chemicals that serve a wide range of industries across the globe.

The company specializes in the production of methylamines, ethylamines, propyl amines, and a diverse portfolio of amine-based derivatives and pharmaceutical intermediates. These chemicals play a crucial role in numerous industrial applications, including agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, rubber chemicals, personal care products, water treatment, and various other end-use industries. Balaji Amines Limited has consistently demonstrated its commitment to quality, innovation, and sustainable manufacturing practices, earning the trust and confidence of customers both domestically and internationally.

Listed on major Indian stock exchanges, Balaji Amines Limited has built a strong reputation for financial stability and operational excellence. The company operates state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities equipped with advanced technology and adheres to stringent quality control standards and environmental regulations.

With a dedicated and skilled workforce, robust research and development capabilities, and a customer-centric approach, Balaji Amines Limited continues to expand its product portfolio and global footprint, reinforcing its position as a reliable and innovative partner in the specialty chemicals industry. The company remains committed to driving growth, delivering value to its stakeholders, and contributing positively to India's chemical manufacturing sector.
